_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); net revenue, client assets, expense, trading activity and pre-tax margin signals with Schwab's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) ... engages, through its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as Schwab or the Company), in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody, and financial advisory services.' 'Developments in the business, economic, and geopolitical environment could negatively impact our business.' 'Our industry is characterized by aggressive price competition.' (FY2018 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a securities broker and bank on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names brokerage or banking, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming or decarbonisation, and the FY2018 10-K names cloud computing only in an accounting standard ('ASU 2018-15, “Intangibles–Goodwill and Other–Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40): Customer’s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement That Is a Service Contract (a consensus of the FASB Emerging Issues Task Force)”'), not as a way its own business is delivered or displaced), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

(FY2018 10-K); DURABLE, risk 2: the 10-K ties results to markets, rates and investor engagement and names price competition, a cycle and a competitive field, and does not call its own business cyclical (the JPM, LOW and SHW reading); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a securities broker and bank on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names brokerage or banking, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming or decarbonisation, and the FY2018 10-K names cloud computing only in an accounting standard ('ASU 2018-15, “Intangibles–Goodwill and Other–Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40): Customer’s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement That Is a Service Contract (a consensus of the FASB Emerging Issues Task Force)”'), not as a way its own business is delivered or displaced), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.50x; -12% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.38; conservative 2yr +84%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -44.1%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.8%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.3%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +36.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: SCHW (retrospective, 2019-06-14) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.50x (65.6% downside to Bear $14.09 / +131.3% upside to Bull $94.87) | Adj composite 3.00 vs market 1.62: gap +1.38 [UNDERVALUED] | -12% above the EPP floor $46.55 (19x FY19E $2.45) | Conservative 2-yr case: +83.6% total (+41.8%/yr) | At 16.7x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $54.24 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +13.6% YoY in Q1 2019, forward revenues +13.6% (Q1 2019 revenue growth (no Q2 2019 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
